flow.name: mf-impl-post-jobs-assess
flow.doc:description: REST entry: maps HTTP body to vars, then calls shared pf-assess-app sub-flow

ee:transform.doc:name: PV SET vars

http:request.doc:name: HTTP GET GitHub
http:request.doc:description: Fetch HEAD commit on defaultBranch to pin all Contents API calls to a consistent tree SHA

http:request.doc:name: HTTP GET CONTENT API
http:request.doc:description: Fetch app pom.xml via Contents API; response contains base64-encoded file content

sub-flow.name: pf-assess-app
sub-flow.doc:description: Shared: assess MuleSoft app for Java 17 upgrade. Called by REST and MCP.

choice.doc:name: CHOICE env empty?
choice.doc:description: Reject immediately if no environment was supplied

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:ENV_REQUIRED
raise-error.description: vars.environment must be set before calling pf-assess-app

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO env present
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'env present | env=' ++ vars.environment ++ ' | owner=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '')]

choice.doc:name: CHOICE coords complete?
choice.doc:description: Reject if owner or repo could not be resolved

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:APP_NOT_REGISTERED
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Cannot resolve repo coordinates for app "' ++ vars.appName ++ '". Provide owner/repo in the registry or request body.']

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO coords present
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'coords ok | owner=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '')]

ee:transform.doc:name: SET headSha and urlPath, queryParams

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- '/repos/' ++ vars.coords.owner ++ '/' ++ vars.coords.repo ++ '/git/trees/' ++ ((payload.sha default '') as String)

set-variable.doc:name: PV SET vars.tree
set-variable.doc:description: Store full tree object for path lookups in subsequent steps

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Analyse Tree
ee:transform.doc:description: Locate appPomPath, mule-artifact.json, CI workflow, and build allProps list from the recursive tree

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import analyzeTree from dwl::treeAnalysis --- analyzeTree(vars.tree, vars.coords.appPath, vars.matrix.gating, vars.matrix.connectors)

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Spread Tree Analysis to flat vars

choice.doc:name: CHOICE app pom.xml located?
choice.doc:description: Fail with a clear 400 when no pom.xml exists at the resolved appPath (e.g. wrong appPath for a monorepo module)

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR app pom not found
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'app pom.xml not found | app=' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ ' | appPath=' ++ (vars.coords.appPath default '.') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '?')]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:APP_NOT_REGISTERED (pom not found)
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'Could not locate a pom.xml for app "' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ '" at path "' ++ (vars.coords.appPath default '.') ++ '" in ' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '?') ++ '. For a multi-module (monorepo) repository, set appPath to the module directory that contains the pom.xml via app-registry.yaml or the request body.']

choice.doc:name: CHOICE app pom content present?
choice.doc:description: Fail clearly when the Contents API returned no readable file content for the app pom (null, directory listing, or oversized)

logger.doc:name: LOG ERROR app pom content empty
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'app pom.xml returned no readable content | app=' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ ' | appPomPath=' ++ (vars.appPomPath default '?') ++ ' | repo=' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '?') ++ ' | url=' ++ (vars.urlPath default '?') ++ ' | rawResponse=' ++ (write(payload, 'application/json', {'indent': false}) default '(unreadable/stream)')]

raise-error.doc:name: RAISE VALIDATION:APP_NOT_REGISTERED (empty app pom)
raise-error.description: #[output application/java --- 'The app pom.xml at "' ++ (vars.appPomPath default '?') ++ '" in ' ++ (vars.coords.owner default '?') ++ '/' ++ (vars.coords.repo default '?') ++ ' could not be read: the Contents API returned no inline file content (the path may be a directory, empty, or the file exceeds the inline size limit). Verify appPath points to the module directory that directly contains the pom.xml.']

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Parse App Pom — init chain
ee:transform.doc:description: Base64-decode app pom content, parse XML, initialise vars.chain, compute next parent path

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import initChain from dwl::pomChain --- initChain(payload.content, vars.appPomPath, (vars.tree.tree map $.path))

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Spread App Pom to flat vars

choice.doc:name: CHOICE fetch parent pom (level 1)?
choice.doc:description: Fetch direct parent pom when app pom declares a resolvable relativePath

flow-ref.doc:name: Flow Ref sf-contents-api-http-get | parent pom.xml level-1
flow-ref.name: sf-contents-api-http-get

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Parse Parent Pom level-1 — update chain
ee:transform.doc:description: Base64-decode parent-1 pom, parse XML, append to vars.chain, compute grandparent path

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import appendParent from dwl::pomChain --- appendParent(payload.content, vars.nextParentPath, vars.chain, (vars.tree.tree map $.path))

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Spread Parent-1 to flat vars

choice.doc:name: CHOICE fetch grandparent pom (level 2)?
choice.doc:description: Fetch grandparent (BOM) pom when the level-1 parent also declared a relativePath

flow-ref.doc:name: Flow Ref sf-contents-api-http-get | grandparent pom.xml level-2
flow-ref.name: sf-contents-api-http-get

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Parse Grandparent Pom level-2 — update chain
ee:transform.doc:description: Base64-decode grandparent pom, parse XML, append to vars.chain (chain is now complete)

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import appendParent from dwl::pomChain --- appendParent(payload.content, vars.nextParentPath, vars.chain, (vars.tree.tree map $.path))

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Spread Grandparent to flat vars

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO grandparent not present
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'chain depth=' ++ sizeOf(vars.chain) ++ ' — no grandparent pom']

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Scan Flags
ee:transform.doc:description: Detect custom Java files, lookup() usage, and build warnings list from tree and pom text

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import scanFlags from dwl::assessment --- scanFlags(vars.tree, vars.appPomText)

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Spread Flags to flat vars

choice.doc:name: CHOICE assess.apiPolicyCheck on?
choice.doc:description: Only read API Manager when the environment opts in via assess.apiPolicyCheck

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN api-policy read failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'assess api-policy read failed (non-fatal) | app=' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ ' | error=' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

choice.doc:name: CHOICE assess.armCrossCheck on?
choice.doc:description: Only read Runtime Manager when the environment opts in via assess.armCrossCheck

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Append ARM cross-check warning

logger.doc:name: LOG WARN arm cross-check failed
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'assess arm cross-check failed (non-fatal) | app=' ++ (vars.appName default '?') ++ ' | error=' ++ (error.description default 'unknown')]

choice.doc:name: CHOICE fetch mule-artifact.json?
choice.doc:description: Fetch and parse mule-artifact.json only when present in the tree

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Decode mule-artifact.json

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries --- read((fromBase64((payload.content default "") replace /[\r\n\t ]/ with "")) as String {encoding: "UTF-8"}, "application/json")

ee:transform.doc:name: DW mule-artifact null

choice.doc:name: CHOICE fetch CI workflow?
choice.doc:description: Fetch CI workflow text only when a workflow path was found

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Decode CI workflow

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import fromBase64 from dw::core::Binaries --- (fromBase64((payload.content default "") replace /[\r\n\t ]/ with "")) as String {encoding: "UTF-8"}

ee:transform.doc:name: DW CI workflow null
DW Classify Topology and build ownerByProperty
ee:transform.doc:description: Derive BOM/PARENT/STANDALONE topology from chain depth and build property→ownerPomPath map

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import classifyTopology from dwl::treeAnalysis --- classifyTopology(vars.chain, vars.allProps)

ee:transform.doc:name: DW Spread Topology to flat vars
DW Build AssessmentResult
ee:transform.doc:description: Apply all matrix upgrade rules to installed property values and produce the full AssessmentResult JSON payload

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import buildAssessmentResult from dwl::assessment --- buildAssessmentResult( vars.matrix, vars.chain, vars.appPomText, vars.muleArtifactCurrent, vars.muleArtifactPath, vars.ciWorkflowText, vars.ciWorkflowPath, vars.appName, vars.topology, vars.headSha, vars.hasApiPolicies, vars.customJavaFound, vars.lookupFound, vars.warnings, (p('upgrade.pomEditStrategy') default 'appOverride'), (((p('matrix.missing.excludeArtifacts') default '') splitBy ',') map trim($) filter ($ != '')))

logger.doc:name: LOG INFO END pf-assess-app done
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'pf-assess-app done | topology=' ++ (vars.topology default 'unknown') ++ ' | fileEdits=' ++ sizeOf(payload.changePlan.fileEdits default []) ++ ' | warnings=' ++ sizeOf(payload.warnings default [])]
